message.text: Customer stated that the dealership said everything was approved and authorized, and now needs to start the process for a rental vehicle while maintenance is done. Please provide instructions for assisting with starting a rental process.

actions.thought: (1.1) The customer wants to start the process for a rental vehicle under their contract. (1.2) The goal is clear and specific—they want to know how to begin the rental process. (2.1) The solution requires retrieving contract and claims data using the get_contract_and_claims_data_V2 API as mandated by task instructions. (2.2) The next action is to make the required API call.
